caseNameFull: Jones, Superintendent, Missouri Training Center for Men at Moberly v. Thomas

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 488 U. S. 1003.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Springfield Baldwin, Esq., of Shrewsburg, Mo., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
